name: Jagjeevan Singh Soni
intro: Software developer with a structured approach to problem solving, a strong sense of ownership, and a commitment to continuous learning.
overviewSummary: Combines a foundation in computer engineering with professional experience in software delivery and cross-functional collaboration. Committed to advancing technical expertise through further study and applying sound engineering judgment to complex challenges.
about: At Amdocs, I work on enterprise telecom systems, from CRM and order management to release automation and production support. My projects extend that engineering practice into audio recognition, computer vision, and brain–computer interfaces.
direction: I am interested in deepening my technical foundations through graduate study, connecting practical software delivery with the study of computing systems and applied machine learning.

areas.title: Enterprise telecom systems
areas.text: Develop and enhance B2B CRM and order-management capabilities using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and Oracle SQL. Collaborate across order orchestration, provisioning, product catalog, and billing integration.

areas.title: Delivery & production ownership
areas.text: Own CRM enhancements from requirements and development through testing, deployment, and issue resolution. Support recurring releases, investigate defects, and coordinate dependencies across technical and business teams.

areas.title: Automation & modernization
areas.text: Built a Python and Flask deployment-validation application for database checks, release tracking, and Excel and email reporting. Migrated application scripts from 32-bit to 64-bit Linux and supported integration validation and production cutover.

areas.title: Developer tooling & notifications
areas.text: Enhanced order-triggered customer notifications and template previews. Automated template conversion, Git check-ins, release packaging, and deployment imports; developed and adapted Java dependency-analysis, SQL rollback, and secure file-transfer utilities.

education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering
education.school: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology

recognition.title: Ownership & Excellence
recognition.text: Recognized for dependable ownership, customer relationships, and technical contributions to CRM release delivery.

recognition.title: Special Recognition
recognition.text: Recognized on two occasions for contributions, sustained commitment, and dedication to work.

recognition.title: Software engineering virtual programs
recognition.text: Completed practical simulations involving stock-price data integration, financial visualization, and password-security analysis.

recognition.title: Secure software development
recognition.text: Completed training in secure coding principles, secure application development, and web application security.

community.title: Event Management Head
